power.greenlantern.tooltip.hold: Hold in either hand, or wear it in a Curios ring slot.
power.greenlantern.tooltip.suit: Use Suit Up to unlock the ring's powers.
item.greenlantern.battery.tooltip.1: Hold in your main hand while wearing a ring of the same corps,
item.greenlantern.battery.tooltip.2: then hold the Recharge key to recite the oath.
ability.greenlantern.uniform.description: Let the ring clothe you in your corps' uniform. The ring's other powers only work while suited up.
ability.greenlantern.ring_protection.des: The ring's life support keeps you safe from drowning, freezing and falling.
ability.greenlantern.construct_fists.des: Hard-light armor protects you and your punches hit much harder.
ability.greenlantern.flight.description: Fly on the power of the ring, leaving a trail of light. Flying slowly drains the ring.
ability.greenlantern.green.beam.descript: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
ability.greenlantern.constructs.descript: Hold to open the construct wheel, then pick a construct to create.
ability.greenlantern.construct_blast.des: Fire a fast bolt of hard light. Costs 40.
ability.greenlantern.construct_fist.desc: Slam everything in front of you with a giant fist, launching it. Costs 100.
ability.greenlantern.construct_cage.desc: Trap the nearest creature within 12 blocks, slowing and weakening it. Costs 150.
ability.greenlantern.construct_slam.desc: Smash the ground with a giant hammer, hurting and launching everything within 6 blocks. Costs 120.
ability.greenlantern.force_field.descrip: Toggle a bubble that blocks projectiles, explosions and fire. Drains the ring while active.
ability.greenlantern.ring_light.descript: Toggle the ring's glow to see in the dark.
ability.greenlantern.recharge.descriptio: Hold your corps' Power Battery in your main hand, then hold this to recite the oath and recharge.
oath.greenlantern.green.1: In brightest day, in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.green.2: No evil shall escape my sight.
oath.greenlantern.green.3: Let those who worship evil's might,
oath.greenlantern.green.4: Beware my power... Green Lantern's light!
ability.greenlantern.roar.description: Let out a roar of raw emotion, knocking back and weakening everything within 7 blocks. Costs 120.
Ultimate: unleash all of your willpower in a blast that hurts and launches everything within 8 blocks. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.beam.descrip: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
oath.greenlantern.yellow.1: In blackest day, in brightest night,
oath.greenlantern.yellow.2: Beware your fears made into light.
oath.greenlantern.yellow.3: Let those who try to stop what's right,
oath.greenlantern.yellow.4: Burn like my power... Sinestro's might!
ability.greenlantern.yellow.inflict_fear: Fill everything within 10 blocks with terror: darkness, slowness and weakness. Costs 120.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.nightmare.de: Show the nearest creature within 12 blocks its worst fear: blinded, dizzy and sluggish. Costs 100.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.fear_incarna: Ultimate: become terror itself, crippling everything within 12 blocks for 15 seconds. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.red.beam.descriptio: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
oath.greenlantern.red.1: With blood and rage of crimson red,
oath.greenlantern.red.2: Ripped from a corpse so freshly dead,
oath.greenlantern.red.4: We'll burn you all... that is your fate!
ability.greenlantern.red.napalm.descript: Hold to spew burning blood plasma that sets your targets on fire.
ability.greenlantern.red.rage.descriptio: Toggle: give in to your rage for Strength II and Speed. Drains the ring while active.
ability.greenlantern.red.blood_rage.desc: Ultimate: a storm of burning rage that hurts, withers and ignites everything within 8 blocks. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.orange.beam.descrip: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
ability.greenlantern.orange.avarice.desc: Your greed drives you: you mine much faster while suited up.
ability.greenlantern.orange.hoard.descri: MINE! Pull every item and experience orb within 16 blocks to you. Costs 50.
ability.greenlantern.orange.life_drain.d: Steal the life of the nearest creature within 10 blocks to heal yourself. Costs 120.
ability.greenlantern.orange.consume.desc: Ultimate: devour the life of everything within 8 blocks and keep it as extra hearts. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.blue.beam.descripti: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
oath.greenlantern.blue.1: In fearful day, in raging night,
oath.greenlantern.blue.2: With strong hearts full, our souls ignite,
oath.greenlantern.blue.3: When all seems lost in the War of Light,
oath.greenlantern.blue.4: Look to the stars... for hope burns bright!
ability.greenlantern.blue.hope_aura.desc: Toggle: you and every player within 8 blocks slowly regenerate health. Drains the ring.
ability.greenlantern.blue.rekindle.descr: Restore hope to every player within 12 blocks: instant healing and extra hearts. Costs 300.
ability.greenlantern.blue.hope_burns_bri: Ultimate: every player within 16 blocks is healed and gains Regeneration and Resistance for 20 seconds. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.beam.descrip: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
oath.greenlantern.indigo.2: Ak wo tauva, Ihla wo nauva,
ability.greenlantern.indigo.phase.descri: Throw a bolt of indigo light and teleport to wherever it lands. Costs 80.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.compassion.d: Make the nearest creature within 12 blocks feel the pain it causes. It can barely fight for 10 seconds. Costs 150.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.healing_touc: Heal every player within 6 blocks. Costs 100.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.staff_of_com: Ultimate: everything within 12 blocks is overwhelmed by empathy and can barely fight for 15 seconds. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.violet.beam.descrip: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
oath.greenlantern.violet.1: For hearts long lost and full of fright,
oath.greenlantern.violet.2: For those alone in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.violet.3: Accept our ring and join our fight,
oath.greenlantern.violet.4: Love conquers all... with violet light!
ability.greenlantern.violet.crystal_pris: Seal the nearest creature within 12 blocks in violet crystal so it cannot move for 8 seconds. Costs 200.
ability.greenlantern.violet.loves_embrac: Heal every player within 8 blocks and give them Regeneration. Costs 150.
ability.greenlantern.violet.charm.descri: Enchant everything within 10 blocks with love so it can barely hurt anyone. Costs 120.
ability.greenlantern.violet.love_conquer: Ultimate: fully heal every player within 16 blocks and pacify everything else around you. Costs 600.
ability.greenlantern.white.beam.descript: Hold to fire a continuous beam from your ring.
ability.greenlantern.white.life_growth.d: While crouching: bring the ground around you to life, turning dirt to grass and cobblestone to moss. Costs 60.
ability.greenlantern.white.life_aura.des: Toggle: you and every player within 10 blocks regenerate health. Drains the ring.
ability.greenlantern.white.entitys_light: Ultimate: a wave of pure life that heals every living thing within 12 blocks and burns the undead. Costs 600.
